scope: Five adopted guide-asset manifests, physical assets/images/guides images, and production source references. No site sources or images modified.

countingRules.rawSourcePath: Unique resolved original file paths; multiple crops from one capture count once.
countingRules.rawSourceContent: Also report unique SHA-256 to reveal identical files saved under different paths.
countingRules.newVersusExisting: Explicit manifest kind/sourceKind; utilities captured 2026-09-07 + task-specific Simulator capture path versus captured 2026-09-03 existing assets.
countingRules.adoptedOnly: Rejected, unused raw capture attempts outside manifests are excluded from raw counts.
countingRules.references: Literal images/guides paths in content, layouts, data, i18n, config.
countingRules.limitation: Hash equality proves the recorded files match the manifests, not semantic UI freshness or live backend behavior. UI freshness is covered in the app audit documents. Temporary source files were verified while available locally.
